summary: cisco.ios deprecates automatic Jinja2 templating of ios_config's src parameter (removed March 2028); use content with the template lookup.
questions: How do I use a Jinja template with ios_config going forward?

answer_card.title: ios_config src templating deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: In `cisco.ios.ios_config`, automatic Jinja2 processing of `src` is deprecated and removed in **March 2028**. Use the `content` parameter with the `ansible.builtin.template` lookup instead.
